target_meaning.1: Client with payment difficulties: late payment more than X days on at least one of the first Y installments (X/Y not disclosed).
target_meaning.0: All other cases; not a guarantee of future repayment.

dictionary.SK_ID_CURR: ID of loan in our sample
dictionary.TARGET: Target variable (1 - client with payment difficulties: he/she had late payment more than X days on at least one of the first Y installments of the loan in our sample, 0 - all other cases)
dictionary.NAME_CONTRACT_TYPE: Identification if loan is cash or revolving
dictionary.FLAG_OWN_CAR: Flag if the client owns a car
dictionary.FLAG_OWN_REALTY: Flag if client owns a house or flat
dictionary.CNT_CHILDREN: Number of children the client has
dictionary.AMT_GOODS_PRICE: For consumer loans it is the price of the goods for which the loan is given
dictionary.NAME_TYPE_SUITE: Who was accompanying client when he was applying for the loan
dictionary.NAME_INCOME_TYPE: Clients income type (businessman, working, maternity leave,…)
dictionary.NAME_EDUCATION_TYPE: Level of highest education the client achieved
dictionary.NAME_HOUSING_TYPE: What is the housing situation of the client (renting, living with parents, ...)
dictionary.REGION_POPULATION_RELATIVE: Normalized population of region where client lives (higher number means the client lives in more populated region)
dictionary.DAYS_BIRTH: Client's age in days at the time of application
dictionary.DAYS_EMPLOYED: How many days before the application the person started current employment
dictionary.DAYS_REGISTRATION: How many days before the application did client change his registration
dictionary.DAYS_ID_PUBLISH: How many days before the application did client change the identity document with which he applied for the loan
dictionary.OCCUPATION_TYPE: What kind of occupation does the client have
dictionary.CNT_FAM_MEMBERS: How many family members does client have
dictionary.REGION_RATING_CLIENT: Our rating of the region where client lives (1,2,3)
dictionary.REGION_RATING_CLIENT_W_CITY: Our rating of the region where client lives with taking city into account (1,2,3)
dictionary.WEEKDAY_APPR_PROCESS_START: On which day of the week did the client apply for the loan
dictionary.HOUR_APPR_PROCESS_START: Approximately at what hour did the client apply for the loan

dictionary.LIVE_REGION_NOT_WORK_REGION: Flag if client's contact address does not match work address (1=different, 0=same, at region level)
dictionary.REG_CITY_NOT_LIVE_CITY: Flag if client's permanent address does not match contact address (1=different, 0=same, at city level)
dictionary.REG_CITY_NOT_WORK_CITY: Flag if client's permanent address does not match work address (1=different, 0=same, at city level)

dictionary.ORGANIZATION_TYPE: Type of organization where client works
